# Guizzprints

> Guizzprints is a multilingual catalog for Minecraft Bedrock and Java builds with previews, direct downloads and 3D guide links.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://guizz.xyz/en/): featured and latest community builds.
- [About](https://guizz.xyz/en/about/): information about Guizzprints.
- [Contact](https://guizz.xyz/en/contact/): public contact channels.
- [Privacy](https://guizz.xyz/en/privacy/): privacy policy.
- [Terms](https://guizz.xyz/en/terms/): terms of use.

## Catalog

- [Minecraft Bedrock](https://guizz.xyz/en/category/bedrock/): Holoprint, MCStructure, MCAddon and MCWorld.
- [Minecraft Java](https://guizz.xyz/en/category/java/): Litematic, Schematic, World and MC Function.

## Languages

- [English](https://guizz.xyz/en/)
- [Español](https://guizz.xyz/es/)
- [Português](https://guizz.xyz/pt/)
